title.narrative: To improve income for ethnic minority youth (ages 1630) in Lao Cai and Hoa Binh provinces through the promotion of career development and entrepreneurship initiatives.

description.narrative: To improve income for ethnic minority youth (ages 1630) in Lao Cai and Hoa Binh provinces through the promotion of career development and entrepreneurship initiatives. Percentage of targeted EM youth in organized sector employment after receiving vocational training

title.narrative: IP1 Percentage of targeted EM youth in organized sector employment after receiving vocational training

description.narrative: IP1 Percentage of targeted EM youth in organized sector employment after receiving vocational training

comment.narrative: The project has successfully achieved its impact indicators. Regarding impact indicator 1 the final evaluation revealed that 71.9 of ethnic minority EM youths secured employment upon completing vocational training supported by the project. Graduates from the projects four vocational programs cooking onsite tour guiding traditional weaving and embroidery primarily found employment in restaurants hotels homestays and embroideryweaving cooperatives. Additionally some youths opted for selfemployment or initiated their own microenterprises instead of seeking formal sector employment.
